title: GTA 6 Online release date: no window confirmed yet
description: The GTA 6 Online release date is still unconfirmed. A Bloomberg video claimed multiplayer arrives a year later, but Jason Schreier says the script was wrong.

body.text: The GTA 6 Online release date is still a mystery, whatever a recent viral video suggested. According to Gamerant, reports pointing to a late 2027 launch for the multiplayer mode come from a misunderstanding, and Rockstar Games has confirmed nothing. For fans who want to know how long they will wait after the main game arrives, the real answer is that nobody outside Rockstar knows.
Where the GTA 6 Online rumour started

On November 13, Bloomberg Originals put a video on YouTube titled "Why the Stakes for GTA 6 Are So High". It looked at the economics and cultural weight of the game and why it could become one of the biggest entertainment launches ever.

Near the end, the narrator said the game releasing in 2026 is not its final form and that multiplayer would follow about a year later. The confident delivery made many fans assume Bloomberg had inside information.
Gamerant says Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier later stated that the narrator's script was wrong, a correction also picked up by Forbes. In other words, the one-year gap was never a confirmed fact.

The claim also gained weight from Twitch CEO Dan Clancy. In a September Bloomberg interview, he predicted a big traffic bump from GTA 6 and an even bigger one the following year when multiplayer launches.
In a later Bloomberg interview in November, Clancy said he had no idea when that would happen. He also denied that Rockstar had told him anything about it.
What we actually know about GTA 6 Online

items: Rockstar has not announced a release window for GTA 6 Online.
The Bloomberg video's one-year claim was an error, per Schreier.
Clancy's comments were guesswork, not information from Rockstar.
Some experts, including Schreier, think 2027 is the likeliest timing, according to Gamerant. That is an expectation, not a confirmation.

body.text: The correction does not guarantee good news either way. The missing date could mean multiplayer lands soon after the base game in November, but there is nothing to support that. Given the game's size and its reportedly rocky development, a longer wait is plausible.
For context, Gamerant notes that GTA Online launched just two weeks after the original GTA 5 release. That history does not set a rule for GTA 6.

Keep an eye on official Rockstar channels, since only the studio can settle this. Until it speaks, treat any specific multiplayer date, including ones that quote big outlets, as speculation. If a claim cannot be traced back to Rockstar, it is not a confirmed release date.

faqs.q: Has Rockstar confirmed the GTA 6 Online release date?
faqs.a: No. According to Gamerant, Rockstar Games has not confirmed any major details about GTA 6 Online, including when it will launch.

faqs.q: Why did people think GTA 6 Online would launch a year after the main game?
faqs.a: A Bloomberg Originals YouTube video said multiplayer would arrive a year after the base game, and Twitch CEO Dan Clancy had made a similar comment in September. Bloomberg's Jason Schreier later said the video script was wrong.

faqs.q: When do experts expect GTA 6 Online to arrive?
faqs.a: Gamerant reports that some experts, including Bloomberg's Jason Schreier, think 2027 is the most likely window. That is an opinion, not an announcement from Rockstar.

sources.title: No, GTA 6 Online Release Window Hasn't Been Confirmed
